envelope.description: Validate gate: Story-scoped typecheck projects and trivial tests

body.title: Validate gate: Story-scoped typecheck projects and trivial tests
body.summary: In src/daemon/steps/build-step/validation-checks.ts: withTypecheckProjects and trivialCheckPlan take an optional storyKey and, with it, select from the Story's set synchronously (storyChangeSet strict plus own-file uncommitted and untracked paths; trivial tests filtered to files that still exist; no base fails the trivial listing); validate.ts passes the storyKey at 348 and 389.
acceptanceChecks: A project owning only unrelated uncommitted or untracked files is not in typecheckProjects; Story and test-file projects are.
A trivial build runs only the Story's existing test files; a deleted test is never asked to run.
Without a storyKey, results are unchanged.

tests.name: src/daemon/steps/build-step/__tests__/validation-checks.test.ts: 'with a storyKey, typecheckProjects holds the Story's projects and its test files' projects, and not a project that owns only unrelated uncommitted or untracked files'

src/daemon/steps/build-step/__tests__/validation-checks.test.ts: 'with a storyKey, the trivial plan runs only the Story's test files, and with no base fails the listing instead of running the HEAD commit's tests'
src/daemon/steps/build-step/__tests__/validation-checks.test.ts: 'with a storyKey, a trivial build that deletes a test file does not ask to run it'
